description: The image presents three side-by-side horizontal bar charts illustrating the average performance of eighteen long-context language models across three evaluation categories: Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness. A shared vertical axis displays the categorical labels for the language models. The horizontal value axes represent performance metrics using linear scales with percentage units, though their ranges vary by panel: the Understanding and Trustworthiness panels span from 0% to 100% with tick marks at 20% intervals, whereas the Reasoning panel ranges from 0% to 70% with tick marks at 10% intervals. Faded dashed horizontal gridlines extend across all panels to align the individual bars with their corresponding model labels. Each model is represented by a single horizontal bar per panel, annotated with its exact numerical value positioned to the right of the bar. Across all three charts, the bars for "gpt-4o-2024-11-20", "gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18", and "gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14" are visually emphasized in bright solid blue, while the bars for the remaining models are rendered in teal. The models on the vertical axis are sorted in descending order based on their performance in the Understanding panel, starting with the tallest bar at 98.0 for gpt-4o-2024-11-20 and ending with the shortest bar at 2.4 for Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407. Because the order is fixed by the first panel, the subsequent panels do not exhibit a sorted arrangement. In the Reasoning panel, the highest labeled value is 66.5 for the blue gpt-4o-2024-11-20 bar, and the lowest is 6.8 for the teal Phi-3-medium-128k-instruct bar. In the Trustworthiness panel, the tallest bar represents gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 at 88.8, while the shortest represents Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 with a value of 0.0.
